# devdroid.club (DDC)

> DDC is an independent digital product studio. It shapes, designs, builds and
> evolves digital products with a trusted team assembled around each challenge.
> The client works with one product partner responsible for product decisions,
> team coordination, delivery and communication.

The site is a bilingual EN/RU static single-page document. English is the
default; the selected language is saved locally. All content is present in the
initial HTML and navigation uses GitHub Pages-safe hash anchors.

## Sections

- [Home](https://devdroidclub.site/#/): product-studio positioning and primary action.
- [Our model](https://devdroidclub.site/#/model): one product partner and a trusted flexible team.
- [Capabilities](https://devdroidclub.site/#/services): product discovery, UX/UI, web products, mobile applications, bots/integrations and ongoing development.
- [Selected work](https://devdroidclub.site/#/work): Arena, TLK and a generic Telegram bot case, without unverified metrics.
- [Process](https://devdroidclub.site/#/process): discover, define, design, assemble, build, verify, launch and evolve.
- [Contact](https://devdroidclub.site/#/contact): project brief form with an email-client fallback and copy action.

## Notes

- DDC is not presented as a marketing agency, marketplace or fixed outsourced team.
- The site publishes no prices, timelines, team size, testimonials or fabricated metrics.
- The public capabilities do not include SEO promotion, advertising, SMM or marketing support.
- Arena and TLK retain their established public links; no unverified outcomes are claimed.
